info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Electronic Engineering

description.describe_ch: 了解醫用電子材料的基本原理和分類。 掌握各種電子材料在生物環境中的特性與挑戰。熟悉醫用材料的生物相容性 (Biocompatibility)、生物安全性 (Biosafety) 和可靠性 (Reliability) 標準。 分析常見醫療電子設備中的材料選擇和設計流程。
description.describe_eh: Understand the basic principles and classifications of medical electronic materials. Master the characteristics and challenges of various electronic materials in biological environments. Be familiar with the biocompatibility, biosafety, and reliability standards for medical materials. Analyze the material selection and design processes in common medical electronic devices.

targets.describe_ch: 能辨識和分類在生物環境中使用的各類電子材料
targets.describe_en: Ability to identify and classify various electronic materials used in biological environments

targets.describe_ch: 能評估材料的生物相容性 (Biocompatibility)、生物安全性 (Biosafety) 和在體內環境中的長期可靠性。
targets.describe_en: Ability to evaluate the material's biocompatibility, biosafety, and long-term reliability in in vivo environments.

targets.describe_ch: 能理解生物介面上的電子傳輸、訊號擷取和能量轉換機制
targets.describe_en: Ability to understand the mechanisms of electron transport, signal acquisition , and energy conversion at the bio-interface
